decisions.rationale: Required lightweight runtime evaluator to provide a testable API and to satisfy plan deliverable 'AchievementEvaluator.cs'.
Project README mandates Editor tests be placed in area folders under Assets/Tests/Editor/. The test originally lived at the root of Editor/ and was relocated to comply with repository conventions.
Minimal persistence and editor tools were required to fulfill plan deliverables for persistence integration and sample content creation in a safe, non-invasive way. Logged for transparency.

tests.summary: Created 2 test files (Editor + Utils). Execution simulated via compile-check; no runtime test runner available.
